title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha longs for a private honeymoon with Cheran, while Chozhan proposes a family trip. Nila convinces Chozhan to stay home, and Pandian and Pallavan opt out.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Mathi refuses to do the household chores alone until someone offers help. Thangaraj fumes when Revathi backs Malar's decision to remain at her mother's house.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 44: Survival Task and Luxury Budget
description: Blue team wins the luxury task after a third round and penalty play, earning luxury shopping. Muniyammal’s food wastage and an unwashed bowl spark clashes between the teams.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam's assurance to bear eye treatment costs and Tamizhselvi's words calm the villagers, who disperse. Then, Aishwarya seeks Tamizhselvi's help to clear Sethupathi's name.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira highlights Sarasu's struggle to meet her basic needs, prompting Kandhasamy to pay his family for their work. Later, the family celebrates receiving their first salaries.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan comforts their crying baby as the naming ceremony preparations conclude. Grateful, Thangamayil names her son 'Gomathi Pandian' in honour of Gomathi and Pandian.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena feels hurt when Rekha avoids Chandra to speak with her. Meanwhile, Muthu hands over the money Sathya gave him for his car repairs to Meena.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi suffers an electric shock, but Poongodi surprisingly cares for him. Azhagar celebrates Suna Pana's birthday, gets drunk, and sneaks into the house, frightening Poongodi.
